title: List of magic items in Act Three
html:
Act One Act Two Act Three

This is a list of all magic equipment that can be acquired in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3, sorted by location.

Campsite

Item Name Item Effect Where to Find Location

Duke Ravengard's Longsword

 Commander's Strike ( + )
Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a  weapon attack. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Carried by  Duke Ulder Ravengard if he is present

Campsite (Act Three)
